channel.title: Fork Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates

item.title: Fork 2.71
item.description:
• Workspaces are now per window: each window shows its own workspace
  • Cmd+click to open workspace in a new window
  • Repository settings and issue tracker rules are shared between worktrees
  • Improved: Top shadow in diff view when scrolled
  • Improved: Faster removal of worktrees
  • Improved: Support ssh.bitbucket.org remote host
  • Fixed: Double-click stages the selected file instead of the clicked one
  • Fixed: Parent repository link not visible for submodules opened in a worktree

item.title: Fork 2.70
item.description:
• Vertical tabs
  • Add Cursor as an AI agent for commit messages
  • Fixed: Crash when deleting worktree from terminal
  • Fixed: Detect cherry-pick and revert state with the reftable backend
  • Fixed: Incorrect rename detection for tiny files
  • Fixed: Backticks in AI-generated commit messages

item.title: Fork 2.69
item.description:
• Add "Save as Patch" option to stash context menu
  • Show warning icon for active branch with invalid upstream
  • Show submodule icon instead of blank file icon in file views
  • Improved: Re-apply context search when switching files in diff view
  • Fixed: Overlapping rows in commit list after fetch
  • Fixed: Submodule diff when the commit is missing
  • Fixed: Crash in binary image diff rendering

item.title: Fork 2.68
item.description:
• Extend tab context menu: Rename, select color, Open in Terminal, Show in Finder
  • Checkout remote branch as worktree
  • Improved: Support pixel diff for 16-bit-RGBA images
  • Fixed: Option+Command+Return (Commit & Push) shortcut not working
  • Fixed: Search overlay remains visible when diff view is hidden
  • Fixed: Out of memory on showing content of very large minified files

item.title: Fork 2.67
item.description:
• New keyboard shortcut for create tag: Shift+Cmd+G
  • Restore closed tabs with Shift+Cmd+T
  • Show commit details popup when press Spacebar
  • Cmd+Up/Down shortcuts for prev/next chunk navigation
  • Tab/Shift-Tab navigation between commit list and commit details
  • Remember collapsed commits between restarts
  • Improved: Bisect UX (button reordering, skip labels, auto-select HEAD)
  • Improved: Snapping for split view in stage view
  • Fixed: Select Left button not clickable in merge conflict editor

item.title: Fork 2.66
item.description:
• Collapsible commit details (Cmd+D)
  • Keyboard navigation in sidebar (arrow keys, Tab to switch between sidebar and commit list)
  • Show if cherry pick or revert can be done without conflicts
  • Add "Copy Repository Path" to sidebar repository menu
  • Fixed 2.66.4: Cmd+Enter commit shortcut is broken for some users
  • Fixed 2.66.4: Submodule revision not updated after resolving merge conflict

item.title: Fork 2.65
item.description:
• Add .gitignore template picker
  • Improved: Add 4 more graph colors
  • Improved: Disambiguate worktree tabs and sidebar items with same folder name
  • Improved: Submodule handling in worktrees
  • Fixed: Submodule add not updating nested submodules
  • Fixed: Reference validation warnings for some users

item.title: Fork 2.64
item.description:
• Add support for reftables
  • Ability to edit default AI agent requests in Integration preferences
  • Add Codex support for AI commit messages and code review
  • Cmd+V to apply patch from clipboard
  • Improved: Add clickable refs to bisect status bar
  • Improved: focus next bisect commit after good/bad/skip

item.title: Fork 2.63
item.description:
• Add `--update-refs` support to Interactive Rebase
  • Add "Create Worktree" dialog, also available via Quick Launch
  • Option to remove corresponding worktree when deleting a branch
  • Show parent repo name in tab header for worktrees
  • Improved: Show Worktrees before Pinned items in sidebar
  • Fixed: Ahead/behind info not shown for branches with worktrees
  • Hotfix 2.63.1: Error when switching ssh keys
  • Hotfix 2.63.2: Window becomes too wide with long branch names

item.title: Fork 2.62
item.description:
• Show ahead/behind counts on pull/push toolbar buttons
  • Add "Select Stale Local Branches" menu item to sidebar
  • Add "Copy Path" to worktree and submodule context menus
  • Add option to enable verbose git output to preferences
  • Improved: Updated fetch, pull, push toolbar button icons
  • Improved: Replace +/- icons with arrows in merge points
  • Hotfix 2.62.1: Sidebar is cut on macOS Tahoe 26.2

item.title: Fork 2.61
item.description:
• Add `--update-refs` option to rebase dialog
  • Add `Cmd+Shift+.` shortcut to toggle reflog or ignored files depending on active view
  • Show avatars in interactive rebase
  • Improved: AI code review can now review SHA ranges
  • Improved: Perform worktree removal on background thread
  • Improved: Updated app icon for dark theme
  • Improved: Hide scroll minimap when document fits within viewport
  • Note: Minimum macOS is now 10.15 (Catalina)

item.title: Fork 2.60
item.description:
• ⭐️ Claude Code Review for branches (requires Claude Code CLI at ~/.local/bin/claude or /opt/homebrew/bin/claude)
  • Add support for multiple source code directories!
  • Add Antigravity to open-in dropdown
  • Improved: Add history for a hunk to File Tree context menu
  • Fixed: Incomplete Bitbucket repository list
  • Fixed: Error when unstaging multiple files when amending
  • Hotfix 2.60.4: High memory usage with default source directory set to home directory

item.title: Fork 2.59
item.description:
• File History for a selected piece of code (available in diff context menu)
  • Branch code review and generate commit message with Claude
  • Show worktree icon for branches checked out in other worktrees
  • Improved: Reduce blinking when when staging/unstaging
  • Improved: Make fetch output less noisy
  • Fixed: In some cases, incorrect conflict recognition for rebase
  • Fixed: Welcome screen doesn't appear on first run on macOS Tahoe
  • Hotfix 2.59.2: Crash on opening new tab for some users

item.title: Fork 2.58
item.description:
• macOS Tahoe improvements
  • Show diff for conflicted files resolved in an external tool
  • In tab header, show first different path component for repos with same name
  • Perform stage/unstage/discard on background thread
  • Improved: Add open in project editor options to submodule context menu
  • Improved: Use new API to request Bitbucket repos. You may need to log in again
  • Fixed: Delete worktree with submodules
  • Fixed: Custom commands don't report stdout in time

item.title: Fork 2.57
item.description:
• Support macOS Tahoe 26
  • Quick Launch: also fuzzy search in file paths
  • Fixed: LFS status list doesn't show files with spaces
  • Fixed: Rare crash when opening QuickLaunch in Checkout Branch mode (Cmd+B)
  • Note: We will soon change minimum macOS to 10.15. Please be prepared.
  • Hotfix 2.57.1: Make app icon look less ugly on older macOS (cr🍏)

item.title: Fork 2.56
item.description:
• Reveal new repos automatically
  • Mark good and bad commits with colors when bisecting
  • For Bitbucket authentication replace deprecated app passwords with new API tokens
  • A lot of internal changes for upcoming macOS Tahoe
  • Increase commit subject font
  • Add experimental 'Review with OpenAI' to branch context menu
  • Note: We will soon change minimum macOS to 10.15 (Catalina). Please be prepared.
  • Fixed: Commit details does not update when clicking on an already focused item on sidebar
  • Fixed: '↩︎' icon showed incorrectly in some cases

item.title: Fork 2.55
item.description:
• Show '↩︎' if commit has a description
  • Reorder and squash commits in active branch using drag and drop
  • Rebase dialog will show if rebase will cause a conflict
  • Generate commit message using OpenAI (you can log in in Fork Preferences)
  • Update git-lfs to 3.7.0
  • Fixed: 'Push tag' hangs when authentication is managed by git-credential-manager
  • Fixed: 'Rebase continue' hangs when submodule requires update
  • Hotfix 2.55.3: Bitbucket token refreshment doesn't work

item.title: Fork 2.54
item.description:
• There are no features in this update, just bug fixes and performance improvements
  • Fixed: Crash when opening a repo with a remote with slashes in the name
  • Fixed: Filter is not updated on rename branch
  • Fixed: Cancel button in custom command doesn't run the action
  • Fixed: Bisect hint not fully visible
  • Hotfix 2.53.3: Update git to 2.50.1
  • Hotfix 2.53.3: 'Patch failed' error when applying stash with conflict
  • Hotfix 2.53.3: Error loading shallow repos for some users
  • Hotfix 2.53.3: Incorrect preselected branch in gitflow dialogs

item.title: Fork 2.53
item.description:
• Draw branch labels with correspoding graph colors
  • Show conflict marks on scrollbar in merger
  • Add ability to reveal diff line in Nova
  • Renamed 'Repository Overview' to 'Repository Treemap'
  • Hotfix 2.53.2: wrong branch label color in some cases

item.title: Fork 2.52
item.description:
• ⭐️ Introducing Repository Overview allowing you to observe repository changes over time. Please give it a try and share your feedback with us. Can it be useful for you? Can it be called better? How can we improve it?
  • Improved: Custom 'checkerboard' background in dark mode
  • Fixed: Pixel image diff does not work for LFS files
  • Fixed: Merge conflict for binary files always looks resolved
  • Fixed: 'Copy Full Path' file context menu is not working
  • Fixed: Remotes list doesn't refresh when remote is created in push dialog
  • Fixed: Checking out previous branch after creating a new one in repo with worktree doesn't work

item.title: Fork 2.51
item.description:
• Add checkbox control to UI Custom Commands
  • Support for .tga images
  • Support for .svg images (macOS Sonoma 14 and newer)
  • Fixed: Custom commands do not display error details when they fail
  • Hotfix 2.51.2: Merging using external tools is not recognized
  • Hotfix 2.51.3: 'Compare to Local changes' doesn't show diff

item.title: Fork 2.50
item.description:
• Highlight search matches in branch labels
  • Add Ghostty terminal
  • Add 'skip' option to bisect
  • Hotfix 2.50.1: Update git-lfs to 3.6.1 (CVE-2024-53263)
  • Breaking change: git-lfs 3.6.0 requires macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
